name: Heroes Tunnel
facts: Heroes Tunnel, a twin-bore marvel, stretches 1,200 feet beneath West Rock Ridge, opening its portals on November 1, 1949, after 1948’s drilling and 1949’s construction sprint.
Renamed in 2003 to honor post‑9/11 heroes, the tunnel’s 63‑foot center-to-center bores were originally chosen to cut $100,000 off a detour around the mountain.
In early 2024, the tunnel’s iconic low‑pressure sodium lamps were swapped for LEDs, sparking debate among drivers who miss the warm glow that once lit the 8‑inch concrete roadways.
